properties.text:
part 2 of my first prepared speech outside the New York Times Building in NYC in which I call out the NYT for their blatant abuse of their constitutional right to freedom of the press by publishing & perpetuating lies & misinformation in favor of the genocidal state of israel & against the very Palestinians being systematically murdered by israel. I call upon the New York Times to grow a fucking backbone and start publishing TRUTH. 
BG music by me
#nyt #newyorktimes #gaza #palestine #press #nyc #protest
